fn-naming-rule.desc: Verifies that every private function/method name starts with `_`.
fn-naming-rule.rationale: Mimics Python's convention. I like it because it makes it easy to tell at a glance whether a function is private or public.
fn-naming-rule.fix: Supports `--fix`: adds the leading `_` to each offending definition and to its uses in the same file.
fn-naming-rule.exemptions: - Methods inside `impl Trait for Type` blocks, since their names are dictated by the trait. - Methods inside a `trait` definition, since trait items carry no visibility modifier of their own. - `fn main`, since the name is fixed by the language.
